listing.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons (ACNHRecomp)
listing.summary: Prepare your own Animal Crossing: New Horizons game and supported update in the experimental ACNHRecomp launcher. Upstream publishes Windows x64, Linux x64 and Apple silicon packages and a separate Android APK. Earlier Ubuntu testing reached the island. Saving, a full day of play and online play remain unverified by Portcove.

steps.title: Extract the original game files
steps.instruction: Use your own copy of Animal Crossing: New Horizons with update 3.0.3. Following the v0.11.0 release instructions, extract the game’s ExeFS and RomFS for the launcher. Keep the working inputs separate from your original copy.

steps.title: Prepare the selected desktop player
steps.instruction: Open the launcher from the package for your computer, choose Prepare the game from your extracted files, and select the files, a writable game folder and its target platforms. Let the launcher finish building before choosing Play.

steps.title: Prepare the Android copy
steps.instruction: Use the Android APK and select a game folder with the extracted exefs and romfs directories, or choose Android as a target on your computer and copy the prepared folder to the phone.

steps.title: Keep your saves
steps.instruction: Keep the user folder inside the game folder or use the upstream save backup before replacing the player.

warnings: The publisher describes the v0.11.0 preparation tests as using synthetic input. Game dumps, saves, graphics drivers and gameplay can still behave differently. Portcove has not qualified setup or gameplay.
